neighbours.label: The token that completes a lexicalised two-part term after its modifier: ' motor' in 'fine motor (skills)', ' cell' in 'basal cell', 'ina' in 'ocarina'; quiet on ' motor' and ' cell' used freely (an engine motor, a prison cell) and on 'gross motor'.
fire: Playing with clay is a great way to work on fine motor skills at home.
The therapist tracked her fine motor progress over six months.
Buttoning a coat takes surprisingly good fine motor coordination.
Stringing pasta onto yarn builds fine motor strength in toddlers.
Doctors removed a small basal cell lesion from his forehead.
Most basal cell tumours grow slowly and rarely spread.
My nephew got a plastic ocarina for his birthday and plays it daily.
The soft notes of an ocarina drifted across the courtyard.
quiet: Playing with clay is a great way to keep children busy at home.
The mechanic replaced the motor in her old lawn mower.
A gross motor game like tag gets children running around.
The motor of the fan hummed loudly all through the night.
Doctors removed a small mole from his forehead last week.
The prisoner spent the night alone in a narrow cell.
My nephew got a plastic flute for his birthday and plays it daily.
The soft notes of a violin drifted across the courtyard.

predictions: median fire ~0.8 (probes: fine motor skills 0.93, fine motor control 0.77, ocarina 1.04, basal cell 0.86); near misses < 0.15 (washing machine motor 0.02, electric motor 0.02, gross motor 0.12).
short: ' motor' in 'fine motor' (+ basal cell, ocarina)
notes: Card: ' motor' x10 (all 'fine motor'), 'ina' x2 (Ocarina), ' cell' x2 (basal cell). The shared pattern seems to be a fixed term's second part, but only these three terms are tested.
